# 👑 pstack for Antigravity & Gemini **Autonomous, rigorous engineering workflows, 45 skills, and Poteto Mode for Google Antigravity & Gemini.** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Google%20Antigravity-4285F4.svg)](https://deepmind.google/technologies/gemini/) [![Upstream](https://img.shields.io/badge/Upstream-cursor%2Fplugins%2Fpstack-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack)
--- ## 💡 What is pstack? `pstack` was created by [Lauren Tan (poteto)](https://x.com/poteto) (React core team, formerly Meta, Netflix, Cursor) to combat AI slop code. > *"There's a growing sense that AI writes too much slop code. I agree. I don't want to ship like a team of twenty slop artists. Throughput without quality is not a goal I aspire to. If you want to go fast, go deep first."* This repository ports `pstack` from Cursor to **Google Antigravity & Gemini**, fully adapting its skills, subagents, playbooks, and principles, while adding **permanent, automated execution** so that every single chat turn automatically operates under the Poteto engineering standard. --- ## 🚀 Quickstart (One-Line Installation) ### 🪟 Windows (PowerShell) Run PowerShell and paste: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dnviti/pstack-antigravity-plugin/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 🍎 macOS / 🐧 Linux (Bash) Run Terminal and paste: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dnviti/pstack-antigravity-plugin/main/install.sh | bash ``` --- ## ⚙️ How It Works in Antigravity In Cursor, `poteto-mode` can be run with `/poteto-mode`. In this Antigravity plugin, `pstack` is configured to operate **automatically and continuously** at three levels: 1. **PreInvocation Lifecycle Hook (`hooks.json`)**: Runs before every turn, injecting dynamic awareness of active playbooks and principles. 2. **Native Plugin Rules (`rules/AGENTS.md` & `rules/GEMINI.md`)**: Enforces automatic playbook selection, verification against runtime evidence, and concise unslopped replies. 3. **Global Machine Rules (`~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`)**: Ensures the Poteto engineering lens is active across all workspaces without requiring user prompting. --- ## 📋 The 23 Task Playbooks Whenever a task is presented, the agent automatically maps it to the right playbook: | Playbook | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | **Investigation** | Read-only question: how does X work, why was Y built this way, are we sure. | | **Bug Fix** | Reproduce defect first, root-cause it, fix with runtime evidence. | | **Feature** | New or changed behavior. Name data shape first per `principle-model-the-domain`. | | **Refactoring** | Behavior-preserving structural change. | | **Perf Issue** | Trace measured slowness and improve against a measured baseline. | | **Hillclimb** | Sustained scientific metric optimization with hypothesis loops. | | **Runtime Forensics** | Diagnose live symptoms (memory leak, CPU spin) from runtime instrumentation. | | **Trace Forensics** | Diagnose profiling artifacts (cpuprofile, trace, spindump, heap snapshot). | | **Prototype** | Throwaway sketch to settle design or behavioral forks empirically. | | **Visual Parity** | Pixel-exact UI equivalence between implementations. | | **Autonomous Run** | Drive a long task to completion without stopping. | | **Babysit** | Drive PR or stack to merge-ready (conflicts, review threads, CI). | | **Shipping** | Independently verify green stack, then land bottom-up. | | **Orchestrate** | Multi-day project coordinator across many stacked PRs and subagents. | | **Session Pickup** | Resume or take over in-flight work from prior agents. | | **Pause Safely** | Suspend in-flight work cleanly for future resumption. | | **Figure-it-out** | Bespoke rigorous playbook when no standard playbook fits. | --- ## 🧠 The 21 Core Engineering Principles - **Laziness Protocol**: Smallest change that solves the problem. Delete before abstracting. - **Foundational Thinking**: Ground logic in core data structures and types first. - **Redesign from First Principles**: Design new requirements as if foundational from day one. - **Subtract Before You Add**: Remove dead weight before building new additions. - **Minimize Reader Load**: Collapse one-caller wrappers, shrink mutable scope. - **Model the Domain**: Use state machines, registries, or domain models instead of scattered booleans. - **Boundary Discipline**: Validate at boundaries; keep domain logic pure. - **Type System Discipline**: Make illegal states unrepresentable. - **Prove It Works**: Every change must be verified against real runtime evidence or test execution. - **Fix Root Causes**: Trace symptoms to underlying source; reproduce before fixing. - **Sequence Work into Verifiable Units**: Decompose work into small verifiable steps. - **Guard the Context Window**: Delegate bulky reads to subagents; summarize in the main thread. - **Never Block on the Human**: Implement quick throwaway probes for reversible forks. --- ## 🛠️ The 45 Workflow Skills Included `architect`, `arena`, `automate-me`, `blast-radius`, `bro`, `create-verification-skill`, `figure-it-out`, `how`, `interrogate`, `maintain-verification-skill`, `make-bot-ui`, `no-comments`, `poteto-mode`, `principle-boundary-discipline`, `principle-build-the-lever`, `principle-encode-lessons-in-structure`, `principle-exhaust-the-design-space`, `principle-experience-first`, `principle-fix-root-causes`, `principle-foundational-thinking`, `principle-guard-the-context-window`, `principle-laziness-protocol`, `principle-make-operations-idempotent`, `principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis`, `principle-minimize-reader-load`, `principle-model-the-domain`, `principle-never-block-on-the-human`, `principle-outcome-oriented-execution`, `principle-prove-it-works`, `principle-redesign-from-first-principles`, `principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state`, `principle-sequence-verifiable-units`, `principle-subtract-before-you-add`, `principle-type-system-discipline`, `recall`, `reflect`, `setup-pstack`, `show-me-your-work`, `swarm`, `tdd`, `teach`, `technical-writing`, `typescript-best-practices`, `unslop`, `why`. --- ## 📦 Manual Installation If you prefer to clone and install manually: ```bash git clone https://github.com/dnviti/pstack-antigravity-plugin.git cd pstack-antigravity-plugin ``` **Windows PowerShell:** ```powershell .\install.ps1 ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash chmod +x install.sh ./install.sh ``` --- ## 🗑️ Uninstallation **Windows PowerShell:** ```powershell .\uninstall.ps1 ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash ./uninstall.sh ``` --- ## 📄 License & Attribution - Original pstack created by [Lauren Tan (poteto)](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack). - Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
